record.label: Fixed rounded DFTHC Hamiltonian
record.statement: The authors take the DFTHC factors for active space X of Compound I from Low et al. and round the coefficients and rotations to 10 and 15 bits, respectively. The model has 63 electrons in 58 spatial orbitals.
record.boundary: The factors are fixed before circuit optimization. The 1 mHa bound applies to this Hamiltonian. The constant energy shift preserves the capped error when the true energy, estimate and cutoff are shifted together. Appendix I.1 separately discusses correlation from orbitals outside active space X.
